apps.localizedDescription: Musly is a free Navidrome client and Subsonic music player with an Apple Music-inspired interface. Stream your self-hosted library from Navidrome, Subsonic, or Airsonic servers on iOS, Android, desktop, and more.

versions.localizedDescription:
## 🎉 Musly v2.0.3

### 📦 Downloads

**Android:**
- `app-release.apk` (universal APK for all devices)

**iOS:**
- `musly-ios.ipa` (sideload with AltStore, Sideloadly, or similar — not signed, iOS 15.0+)

**Windows:**
- `musly-setup.exe` (setup installer, run to install Musly)
- `musly-windows.zip` (portable version, extract and run)

**macOS:**
- `musly-macos.dmg` (drag Musly.app to Applications — not notarized)

**Linux:**
- `*.deb` (Debian, Ubuntu, Linux Mint)
- `*.rpm` (Fedora, RHEL, openSUSE)
- `*.pkg.tar.zst` (Arch Linux, Manjaro)
- `*.AppImage` (Universal AppImage for any distro)
- `*.flatpak` (Flatpak standalone bundle)
- `*.snap` (Snap package)
- `*.tar.gz` (portable standalone tarball)

**Tizen Smart TV:**
- `*.tpk` (Native version for Tizen 4.0+ / 2018 or newer TVs)

### 📝 Changelog
See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/dddevid/Musly/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)
